title: Quieter, steadier background work
summary: Three places threw an exception on every pass and caught it again — harmless in themselves, but they filled the log with stack traces and made real problems hard to see. Found by watching a phone's log for a minute rather than by reading code.

changes.title: Group maintenance no longer throws on every group
changes.description: The periodic check asked the database for a group's row and took the first result without checking there was one. For a group the network knows about but the database does not — which happens for a moment right after creating one — that threw, and the check runs for every group on every pass. It now asks for a single row and looks. If a group really has no database row, the log says so plainly instead of printing a stack trace: that state means the group cannot appear in the chat list, and it is worth seeing.

changes.title: No more exception on every screen resume
changes.description: Returning to the app hid a loading indicator that may not exist yet, throwing a null-pointer exception each time, and read the settings database before it was open — twice, once for the push token. All three are guarded now. The push token was already re-read later, so nothing was lost, but the app no longer starts by throwing three exceptions.
